title: The Other Side of the Line

scenes.stage_direction: The room grows quieter as live contact approaches. The last call is real; physical reunion is still beyond this campaign.

dialogues.speaker: Amara
dialogues.text: Can he hear me for a little longer?

dialogues.speaker: David
dialogues.text: Yes. The visitor is still beside him.

dialogues.speaker: Amara
dialogues.text: Then keep the line open. Finish the notice while I talk to my son.

dialogues.speaker: David
dialogues.text: Amara… the representative named for the assessment was also at Adrian's last appointment.

metadata.evidence_summary: Ethan is alive at a verified placement; a supervised return assessment is scheduled, not completed.
